dishes.name: Leuven stoverij
dishes.desc: Beef stewed in dark beer with mustard bread, the Flemish carbonade. In Leuven, home of a brewing tradition, beer sets it apart.

dishes.name: Witloof gratin
dishes.desc: Chicory wrapped in ham and baked in cheese sauce. Flemish Brabant is the heart of Belgian chicory growing.

dishes.name: Hageland strawberries
dishes.desc: Local strawberries, fresh or in tarts, grown in the Hageland fruit and farm region east of Leuven.

dishes.name: Cheese croquette
